// About

One developer, startup speed to AAA scale

I specialize in Unity and C# to build high-quality games for mobile and PC. Having worked in environments ranging from small startups to large corporations — both remote and onsite — I adapt quickly while keeping a strong foundation in technical execution, project management, and cross-functional communication.

My core expertise covers Design Patterns, Unity 2D/3D, UniRx, multi-platform development and MVC architecture, with specialized experience in performance optimization, casual / hybrid-casual development and Playable Ads. I led a 4-member team at NCC Asia, shipped Web3 titles whose token listed on Bitget & Gate.io, and today I prototype publisher-tested casual hits at TrippleQ Studio while integrating AI-assisted workflows into daily production.

I'm deeply passionate about delivering innovative gaming experiences and committed to continuous learning and technical excellence.
